newsitem.title: USA: Group calls for easing of US agricultural trade options.
newsitem.headline: Group calls for easing of US agricultural trade options.

text.p: The U.S. National Grain and Feed Association said Friday it had filed a petition asking the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to lift its ban on agricultural trade, or off-exchange, options.

The petition calls on the CFTC to adopt amendments to existing regulations that would permit trade options on agricultural commodities to the same extent as currently permitted for non-agricultural commodities.
The CFTC proposed such changes in 1991, but did not publish final rules.
Now would be an opportune time to complete the process, given changes in U.S. farm law last year and other factors, the NGFA said in a newsletter.
"A majority of the current commissioners appear to favor providing more market-based risk-management tools for use by agricultural producers," the group said.
